notes: Puffy white PE mailer with a rounded, asymmetrically wrinkled pillow shell and a continuous 2 mm compressed heat-sealed perimeter flange at mid-height. A/B/C change only the 90x60 mm QF Express label artwork, skewed -2 degrees. Logo, tracking numbers, decorative random bars and addresses are fictional. The explicitly required single 196Y x76X x33Z box collider is centred at z17.5 mm. It necessarily protrudes more than the generic 1 mm tolerance near the curved pillow corners and omits the thin thermal flange; this task-specific box-proxy requirement takes precedence over a close-fitting convex decomposition. Metres, Z up, front -X; all meshes and proxies share the prop origin and identity transforms. Smart UV 66 degrees with 0.01 island margins; 30-degree split smoothing and exported normals. Albedo is CPU Cycles 64-sample diffuse COLOR * (0.4 + 0.6 * AO), 8-bit sRGB; no direct light or highlights. Full procedural Principled PBR and source label UVs are packed in source.blend. Colour grain is centred on nominal colour with about +/-3 percent variation. Generated with Blender 5.2.0 LTS. Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 6 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification. Task 13 delivery: baked albedos are Lanczos-downsampled to at most 1024 px except the unchanged-resolution factory-floor repeat tile; previews are 512 square. PNG encoding uses RGB8 or reviewed 256-colour Floyd-Steinberg palettes; source artwork pixels and source.blend are retained. Shared PNG paths resolve from this prop folder.
